entities.name: Sentos
entities.description: A twenty-six-year-old veteran of the war in Thune who ended it by sparing a false king, and who is petrified after killing himself fails to go as planned.

entities.name: Gorgon of Xathrid
entities.description: A cursed gorgon from Xathrid who tortures Sentos for the eyes of a righteous man demanded by a demon, and who takes the ring.

entities.name: False King
entities.description: A silver-haired man of unnaturally long life whom Sentos spared on Fleet Rock and who gave him the ring.

entities.name: Ring of ceaseless life
entities.description: A ring that grants ceaseless life, given to Sentos by the false king and taken by the gorgon.

entities.name: Demon
entities.description: A demon to whom the gorgon is cursed to pay the eyes of a righteous man.

entities.name: Jenna
entities.description: The author who introduces the story.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A vast plane containing Thune and the eastern lands.

entities.name: Thune
entities.description: The western land, whose border mountains hold the monastery where Sentos lives.

entities.name: An Karras
entities.description: Sentos's birth city, an ancient city that venerates Sentos the Righteous.

entities.name: Fleet Rock
entities.description: The place where the war ended and Sentos spared the false king.

entities.name: Monastery in the borderland mountains
entities.description: The monastery where Sentos lives in a monk's cottage.

events.summary: Sentos sits alone in a monk's cottage, holding a flask of poison and ring from the day he ended the war on Fleet Rock, resolving to drink to oblivion.
Sentos wakes after the wind slams the door, finds the poison flask empty and shattered, and sees a statue of a frightened monk outside.
events.quote: But the stonecutter had carved fear into the monk's elderly features.

events.summary: A woman holds a blade to Sentos's throat and demands to know whether he is Sentos the Merciful.
The woman stabs Sentos in the back and makes him recount what happened on Fleet Rock, and he says the silver-haired man was the false king.
events.quote: "No one told me he was the false king."

events.summary: Sentos lies that he spared the false king out of mercy, concealing that he accepted the ring for his wife.
events.quote: I did it out of mercy." It was a lie he'd told many times before

events.summary: The woman reveals she is cursed and that a demon demands the eyes of a righteous man.
events.quote: A demon requires payment. He demands the eyes of a righteous man.

events.summary: She pushes back her hood and reveals herself as a gorgon of Xathrid whose gaze petrifies.
events.quote: A gorgon, a monster of Xathrid, with the power to petrify a man with her gaze.

events.summary: Sentos grabs a shard of the broken flask and stabs the gorgon in the heart, releasing a flood of black snakes.
events.quote: Sentos grabbed a shard of glass, whirled around, and plunged into her heart.

events.summary: The snakes bite Sentos and petrify when they meet the gorgon's gaze; she pins him with her foot.
events.quote: The gorgon's foot slammed into the back of his neck, pinning him down in the nest of petrified snakes.

events.summary: The gorgon cuts off Sentos's finger and takes the ring, which grants ceaseless life.
events.quote: With her blade, she sliced off his finger, taking the ring for her own.

events.summary: Without the ring, the venom kills Sentos; he looks the gorgon in the face and is turned to stone, and her blade strikes stone.
events.quote: But he heard the tip of her blade meet the stone of his face.

relations.note: She is cursed to bring the demon the eyes of a righteous man.
relations.quote: I am cursed. A demon requires payment.

relations.note: She petrifies him after taking the ring.
relations.quote: Instead, Sentos twisted his neck and gazed at the gorgon's face.

relations.note: Sentos spared the false king and received his ring.
relations.quote: I gave him his freedom for the trinket anyway.

relations.note: Sentos's birth city lies near the border mountains.
relations.quote: An hour to the east is An Karras, the city of my birth.

relations.note: The border of Thune lies in the mountains of Shandalar.
relations.quote: the mountains at the border of Thune in Shandalar
